# Frappe MCP

> Standalone, permission-aware Model Context Protocol server for Frappe sites. Runs as a local MCP stdio process and connects over Frappe HTTP APIs. It is not installed as a Frappe app.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): install, configuration, capabilities, and links.
- [Installation](docs/installation-and-configuration.md): Python install, environment, host config, and removal.
- [AI agent guide](docs/ai-agent-guide.md): safe discovery, read, mutation, customization, export, and rollback workflows.
- [Tool reference](docs/tool-reference.md): current tools, arguments, caps, and unsupported features.
- [Frappe capability study](docs/frappe-capability-study.md): framework/ERPNext capability inventory, current coverage, visual-equivalence checks, and test strategy.
- [Manual functional verification](e2e/manual_functional_report.md): live Administrator checks for DocTypes, generated artifacts, database persistence, customizations, and defects.
- [Security](docs/security.md): credentials, native permissions, previews, and file boundaries.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): stdio, HTTP authentication, and local app exports.
- [Compatibility and validation](docs/compatibility-and-validation.md): tested site stack, evidence, and release limits.
- [Development](docs/development.md): unit tests and real local-site acceptance scripts.
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md): implemented scope and planned Frappe surfaces.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting.

## Important rules

- Discover target app/module/DocType metadata; do not assume an ERPNext or HRMS catalog.
- Use Frappe's permissions. Do not bypass denied access.
- Preview mutations and confirm only after review. Updates/deletes require the preview's exact `modified` token.
- Export only to an explicitly configured local app root; review the diff and use normal Git/deployment workflows.
- Do not expose credentials in prompts, config committed to source, logs, or test evidence.
- Arbitrary SQL/Python and unrestricted method dispatch are not provided.
